# vergeio_vm_snapshots (Data Source)

Lists `machine_snapshots` for one VM. `vm_id` is the VM `$key`, the same value as `vergeio_vm.id`, not the machine key. Rows are ordered by `created`, then by snapshot key. This data source does not create or change a snapshot.

`machine` is the parent VM's machine key. `snap_machine` is the machine key of the snapshot VM (`is_snapshot` true). [`vergeio_vm_clone`](../resources/vm_clone.html) clones that VM. `expires` is null when the snapshot does not expire.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vergeio_vm_snapshots" "source" {
  vm_id = vergeio_vm.source.id
}

output "newest_snapshot" {
  value = data.vergeio_vm_snapshots.source.snapshots[length(data.vergeio_vm_snapshots.source.snapshots) - 1].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_id` (String) VM $key, the same value as `vergeio_vm.id`.

### Read-Only

- `snapshots` (Attributes List) Snapshots of this VM, including ones this configuration did not create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--snapshots))

<a id="nestedatt--snapshots"></a>
### Nested Schema for `snapshots`

Read-Only:

- `created` (Number) Creation time as a Unix timestamp.
- `expires` (Number) Expiration time as a Unix timestamp. Null when the snapshot does not expire.
- `id` (String) `machine_snapshots` key.
- `machine` (Number) Parent VM machine key. `machine_snapshots.machine`, not the VM $key.
- `name` (String) Snapshot name.
- `snap_machine` (Number) Machine key of the snapshot VM (`is_snapshot` true). `vergeio_vm_clone` clones that VM.
